# Fictional intake protocol for a counseling service

Step 1. Greet the client and explain confidentiality.

Step 2. Ask about sleep, then about work, then about support from others.

Step 3. If the client mentions thoughts of self-harm, ask directly about safety and name the crisis line 90101.

A session lasts at most 50 minutes.

Session fees by length: sessions of up to 30 minutes cost 500 kronor, and sessions of up to 45 minutes cost 700 kronor.
